dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a significant notch discontinuity located approximately midway between the apex and posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a smooth pixel radius at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a variable gradient steepening towards the apex relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible base width is approximately 1.8 times the maximum vertical height of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant triangular notch on the trailing edge; series of circular white lesions/spots present on both the posterior margin and the anterior basal region.
